```{python}
q = """
    SELECT *
      FROM parks
"""

parks = pl.read_database(q, con)
```


```{python}
q = """
    SELECT *
      FROM schools
"""

schools = pl.read_database(q, con)
```



```{python}
parks.join(schools, on="city")
```



```{python}
parks.join(schools, 
          on=["city", "state"], 
          # left_on=["city", "state"],
          # right_on=["city"],
          how="outer"
).filter(pl.col("city") == "Seattle") 
```

```{python}
parks.filter(pl.col("city") == "Seattle")
```
